title: Pipeline configuration
description: Schema for config/pipeline.yaml — controls sources, output languages and generation, execution settings, profiles, and modernization targets.

copilot.description: Copilot model default; overridden by -CopilotModel. Omit default_model to retain agent-specific model selection, then auto.

default_model.description: Copilot CLI model ID (e.g. claude-sonnet-4.5), or auto. Empty and null values are invalid.

source_root.description: Absolute path (or relative to repo root) to the folder containing COBOL/JCL sources.

include.description: Folder names or globs relative to source_root. Folder names are scanned recursively.

platform.description: Default COBOL runtime platform. ibmi covers IBM i (AS/400) ILE COBOL sources.

platforms.description: Per-file platform overrides keyed by glob relative to source_root.

output.description: Documentation output defaults for both public pipeline runners.

generate.description: File and group outputs for default runs. Missing switches default to true. Required prerequisites are included automatically; explicit phase/range selectors override this selection.

docs.description: Generate section/file/group documentation and overview diagrams.

functional_analysis.description: Generate file/group functional analysis, including documentation and requirements prerequisites.

requirements.description: Generate file/group requirements, including documentation prerequisites.

technical_analysis.description: Generate file/group technical analysis, including documentation prerequisites.

languages.description: Exact documentation language codes, e.g. [it] or [en, it]. Defaults to English only when unspecified. The static portal currently supports en and it.

pipeline.description: Public runner Copilot concurrency and declarative orchestrator execution settings.

copilot_parallelism.description: Maximum concurrent Copilot tasks per stage in both public runners. Overridden by -CopilotThrottle and explicit phase-specific throttle options.

execution_mode.description: Declarative orchestrator setting, not read by public runners. per-file-loop: file-scoped phases end-to-end per file, then workspace phases. per-phase: DAG-wide execution.

per_file_parallelism.description: Declarative orchestrator file concurrency when execution_mode=per-file-loop. Not read by public runners.
